BOOK2_LESSON_TEN_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–4 · Let’s Go Work Out after Class!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Not Only…, But Also… with 不但…而且…
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Link two clauses to add a second, stronger point.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern connects two short sentences. The latter sentence shows a higher degree than the former. (1) If the two sentences have the same Subject, the Subject is placed before “不但”, and the Subject in the second sentence can be omitted. (2) If the two sentences have different Subjects, the Subjects should be placed after “不但” and “而且” respectively, e.g., “我做的菜，不但爸爸喜歡，而且媽媽也喜歡。”
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern connects two short sentences. The latter sentence shows a higher degree than the former. (1) If the two sentences have the same Subject, the Subject is placed before “不但”, and the Subject in the second sentence can be omitted. (2) If the two sentences have different Subjects, the Subjects should be placed after “不但” and “而且” respectively, e.g., “我做的菜，不但爸爸喜歡，而且媽媽也喜歡。”
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern connects two short sentences. The latter sentence shows a higher degree than the former. (1) If the two sentences have the same Subject, the Subject is placed before “不但”, and the Subject in the second sentence can be omitted. (2) If the two sentences have different Subjects, the Subjects should be placed after “不但” and “而且” respectively, e.g., “我做的菜，不但爸爸喜歡，而且媽媽也喜歡。”
grammarPages.pattern: S + 不但 + clause，(而且) + clause

text.traditional: A：你會說中文嗎？B：我不但會說中文，而且會說台灣話。
text.simplified: A：你会说中文吗？B：我不但会说中文，而且会说台湾话。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ huì shuō Zhōngwén ma? B: Wǒ búdàn huì shuō Zhōngwén, érqiě huì shuō Táiwān huà.
text.english: A: Can you speak Chinese? B: I can speak not only Chinese but also Taiwanese.

text.traditional: A：你為什麼來台灣旅行？B：因為台灣不但風景美，而且交通也很方便。
text.simplified: A：你为什么来台湾旅行？B：因为台湾不但风景美，而且交通也很方便。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ wèishénme lái Táiwān lǚxíng? B: Yīnwèi Táiwān búdàn fēngjǐng měi, érqiě jiāotōng yě hěn fāngbiàn.
text.english: A: Why did you come to Taiwan? B: Because Taiwan has not only beautiful scenery, but also very convenient transportation.

text.traditional: 媽媽：你打掃房間了嗎？孩子：我不但把房間打掃好了，而且髒衣服也洗乾淨了。
text.simplified: 妈妈：你打扫房间了吗？孩子：我不但把房间打扫好了，而且脏衣服也洗干净了。
text.pinyin: Māma: Nǐ dǎsǎo fángjiān le ma? Háizi: Wǒ búdàn bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo hǎo le, érqiě zāng yīfu yě xǐ gānjìng le.
text.english: Mom: Did you clean your room? Child: I not only cleaned the room up, but also washed the dirty clothes.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize an extreme state, usually a negative one.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern shows exaggeration with a higher degree than “Vs 得不得了” and “Vs 極了”. In most cases, it implies negative meanings. However, there are a small number of state verbs that can be used to show positive emotions, e.g., “高興死了”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern shows exaggeration with a higher degree than “Vs 得不得了” and “Vs 極了”. In most cases, it implies negative meanings. However, there are a small number of state verbs that can be used to show positive emotions, e.g., “高興死了”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern shows exaggeration with a higher degree than “Vs 得不得了” and “Vs 極了”. In most cases, it implies negative meanings. However, there are a small number of state verbs that can be used to show positive emotions, e.g., “高興死了”.

text.traditional: 百貨公司的大衣貴死了，我買不起。
text.simplified: 百货公司的大衣贵死了，我买不起。
text.pinyin: Bǎihuò gōngsī de dàyī guì sǐ le, wǒ mǎi bù qǐ.
text.english: The coats at the department store are incredibly expensive; I can’t afford one.

text.traditional: 昨天晚上隔壁鄰居一直在跳舞，吵死了。
text.simplified: 昨天晚上隔壁邻居一直在跳舞，吵死了。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng gébì línjū yìzhí zài tiàowǔ, chǎo sǐ le.
text.english: The neighbors next door danced all last night. It was terribly noisy.

text.traditional: 教授要我用中文報告在台灣的生活，讓我緊張死了。
text.simplified: 教授要我用中文报告在台湾的生活，让我紧张死了。
text.pinyin: Jiàoshòu yào wǒ yòng Zhōngwén bàogào zài Táiwān de shēnghuó, ràng wǒ jǐnzhāng sǐ le.
text.english: The professor asked me to give a report in Chinese about my life in Taiwan, which made me incredibly nervous.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.titleEnglish: The More…, the More… with 越…越…
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Show how a change in one degree or action affects another.
grammarPages.explanation: When the subject does the first action, the situation changes accordingly with the increase or decrease in the degree or number. The structure is “S 越 V₁/Vs₁ 越 V₂/Vs₂”. Besides, this pattern can have a second subject. When the first subject does something more frequently, the state of the second subject will change accordingly. The pattern is “S₁ 越 V₁/Vs₁，S₂ 越 V₂/Vs₂”.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When the subject does the first action, the situation changes accordingly with the increase or decrease in the degree or number. The structure is “S 越 V₁/Vs₁ 越 V₂/Vs₂”. Besides, this pattern can have a second subject. When the first subject does something more frequently, the state of the second subject will change accordingly. The pattern is “S₁ 越 V₁/Vs₁，S₂ 越 V₂/Vs₂”.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: When the subject does the first action, the situation changes accordingly with the increase or decrease in the degree or number. The structure is “S 越 V₁/Vs₁ 越 V₂/Vs₂”. Besides, this pattern can have a second subject. When the first subject does something more frequently, the state of the second subject will change accordingly. The pattern is “S₁ 越 V₁/Vs₁，S₂ 越 V₂/Vs₂”.
grammarPages.pattern: S + 越 + V₁/Vs₁，(S₂) + 越 + V₂/Vs₂

text.traditional: 山本良介的中文越說越好了。
text.simplified: 山本良介的中文越说越好了。
text.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè de Zhōngwén yuè shuō yuè hǎo le.
text.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke’s Chinese is getting better and better.

text.traditional: 中文的語法不容易，老師越說，我越不懂。
text.simplified: 中文的语法不容易，老师越说，我越不懂。
text.pinyin: Zhōngwén de yǔfǎ bù róngyì, lǎoshī yuè shuō, wǒ yuè bù dǒng.
text.english: Chinese grammar isn’t easy. The more the teacher explains, the less I understand.

text.traditional: 房子離捷運站越近，房租越貴。
text.simplified: 房子离捷运站越近，房租越贵。
text.pinyin: Fángzi lí jiéyùn zhàn yuè jìn, fángzū yuè guì.
text.english: The closer a house is to the MRT station, the more expensive the rent.

text.traditional: 他很喜歡工作，事情越多，他越高興。
text.simplified: 他很喜欢工作，事情越多，他越高兴。
text.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān gōngzuò, shìqíng yuè duō, tā yuè gāoxìng.
text.english: He really likes working. The more things he has to do, the happier he is.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Pressing for an Answer with 到底
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 到底 in a question when the speaker is eager to know the answer.
grammarPages.explanation: “到底” is an adverb which is used in disjunctive questions except for those with final “嗎”, e.g., “到底要不要？” and “到底去不去？” It shows the emotion that the speaker is eager to know the answer. It can be placed before or after the Subject, but when the Subject is a question word, “到底” can only be placed in front of the Subject and used as an adverbial, e.g., “到底是誰偷了我的車？”
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: “到底” is an adverb which is used in disjunctive questions except for those with final “嗎”, e.g., “到底要不要？” and “到底去不去？” It shows the emotion that the speaker is eager to know the answer. It can be placed before or after the Subject, but when the Subject is a question word, “到底” can only be placed in front of the Subject and used as an adverbial, e.g., “到底是誰偷了我的車？”
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “到底” is an adverb which is used in disjunctive questions except for those with final “嗎”, e.g., “到底要不要？” and “到底去不去？” It shows the emotion that the speaker is eager to know the answer. It can be placed before or after the Subject, but when the Subject is a question word, “到底” can only be placed in front of the Subject and used as an adverbial, e.g., “到底是誰偷了我的車？”
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 到底 + question; 到底 + question word + clause

text.traditional: 我要訂位了，你明天到底要不要跟我們去 KTV？
text.simplified: 我要订位了，你明天到底要不要跟我们去KTV？
text.pinyin: Wǒ yào dìngwèi le, nǐ míngtiān dàodǐ yào búyào gēn wǒmen qù KTV?
text.english: I’m about to make a reservation. Are you actually coming to KTV with us tomorrow, or not?

text.traditional: 到底要用幾張貼紙才換得到便利商店的禮物呢？
text.simplified: 到底要用几张贴纸才换得到便利商店的礼物呢？
text.pinyin: Dàodǐ yào yòng jǐ zhāng tiēzhǐ cái huàn dédào biànlì shāngdiàn de lǐwù ne?
text.english: How many stickers does it actually take to exchange for the convenience store’s gift?

text.traditional: 我不知道林老師到底住在學校前面還是後面的社區。
text.simplified: 我不知道林老师到底住在学校前面还是后面的社区。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào Lín lǎoshī dàodǐ zhù zài xuéxiào qiánmiàn háishì hòumiàn de shèqū.
text.english: I don’t know whether Teacher Lin actually lives in the neighborhood in front of the school or the one behind it.

text.traditional: （美心戴著口罩，一直咳嗽）
text.simplified: （美心戴着口罩，一直咳嗽）
text.pinyin: (Měixīn dài zhe kǒuzhào, yìzhí késòu)
text.english: (Meixin wears a mask and keeps coughing.)

text.traditional: 妳怎麼了？生病了嗎？
text.simplified: 你怎么了？生病了吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ zěnmele? Shēngbìng le ma?
text.english: What’s wrong with you? Are you feeling ill?

text.traditional: 我鼻子很不舒服，感冒一個星期了。不但頭痛，而且還拉肚子。等一下要去看病。
text.simplified: 我鼻子很不舒服，感冒一个星期了。不但头痛，而且还拉肚子。等一下要去看病。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bízi hěn bù shūfu, gǎnmào yíge xīngqí le. Búdàn tóutòng, érqiě hái lādùzi. Děng yíxià yào qù kànbìng.
text.english: There’s something weird with my nose. I caught a cold for a week. I not only have a headache, but also have diarrhea. I’m going to see a doctor later.

text.traditional: 我陪妳去吧！不過妳老是不運動，對身體不好喔！
text.simplified: 我陪你去吧！不过你老是不运动，对身体不好喔！
text.pinyin: Wǒ péi nǐ qù ba! Búguò nǐ lǎoshì bú yùndòng, duì shēntǐ bùhǎo o!
text.english: I’ll go with you! But you never exercise at all. This is not good for your body!

text.traditional: 我知道這樣的壞習慣應該改一改，可是……
text.simplified: 我知道这样的坏习惯应该改一改，可是……
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào zhèyàng de huài xíguàn yīnggāi gǎi yì gǎi, kěshì…
text.english: I know I should get out of those bad habits, but…

text.traditional: （良介走過來）
text.simplified: （良介走过来）
text.pinyin: (Liángjiè zǒu guò lái)
text.english: (Ryosuke comes over.)

text.traditional: 我要去健身房運動，要不要一起去？
text.simplified: 我要去健身房运动，要不要一起去？
text.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù jiànshēnfáng yùndòng, yào búyào yìqǐ qù?
text.english: I am going to the gym to work out. Would you like to go together?

text.traditional: 我從小就最討厭運動，每次上體育課，老師都要我們在操場上，一下子跑、一下子跳，我的腿跟脖子都痛死了。
text.simplified: 我从小就最讨厌运动，每次上体育课，老师都要我们在操场上，一下子跑、一下子跳，我的腿跟脖子都痛死了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù zuì tǎoyàn yùndòng, měi cì shàng tǐyù kè, lǎoshī dōu yào wǒmen zài cāochǎng shàng, yíxiàzi pǎo, yíxiàzi tiào, wǒ de tuǐ gēn bózi dōu tòng sǐ le.
text.english: I’ve hated sport since childhood. Everytime, when we had a PE class on the playground, the teacher asked us to run one minute and to jump the next. My legs and neck hurt terribly!

text.traditional: 妳太誇張了！體育課都是比較輕鬆的運動啊！
text.simplified: 你太夸张了！体育课都是比较轻松的运动啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ tài kuāzhāng le! Tǐyù kè dōu shì bǐjiào qīngsōng de yùndòng a!
text.english: You are exaggerating! The exercise in PE class is easier!

text.traditional: 可是有一次老師要我們跑一千五百公尺，跑到一半，我就覺得好像快死了，老師趕快叫救護車把我送到醫院，才救了我一命呢！
text.simplified: 可是有一次老师要我们跑一千五百公尺，跑到一半，我就觉得好像快死了，老师赶快叫救护车把我送到医院，才救了我一命呢！
text.pinyin: Kěshì yǒu yí cì lǎoshī yào wǒmen pǎo yìqiānwǔbǎi gōngchǐ, pǎo dào yíbàn, wǒ jiù juéde hǎoxiàng kuài sǐ le, lǎoshī gǎnkuài jiào jiùhùchē bǎ wǒ sòng dào yīyuàn, cái jiù le wǒ yí mìng ne!
text.english: But once, the teacher asked us to run 1500 meters. Having run half of it, I felt like I was about to die. The teacher quickly called an ambulance to take me to the hospital, which saved my life!

text.traditional: 現在我知道妳為什麼這麼討厭運動了！
text.simplified: 现在我知道你为什么这么讨厌运动了！
text.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ zhīdào nǐ wèishénme zhème tǎoyàn yùndòng le!
text.english: Now I know why you hate exercise so much!

text.traditional: 其實健身沒有妳想的那麼難，只要每天照健身教練說的做，就會越做越輕鬆的。
text.simplified: 其实健身没有你想的那么难，只要每天照健身教练说的做，就会越做越轻松的。
text.pinyin: Qíshí jiànshēn méiyǒu nǐ xiǎng de nàme nán, zhǐyào měitiān zhào jiànshēn jiàoliàn shuō de zuò, jiù huì yuè zuò yuè qīngsōng de.
text.english: Actually, working out is not as hard as you think. As long as you follow the instructions of your fitness coach every day, it should be getting easier and easier.

text.traditional: 我最近變胖了，健身能讓我瘦一點兒嗎？
text.simplified: 我最近变胖了，健身能让我瘦一点儿吗？
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn biàn pàng le, jiànshēn néng ràng wǒ shòu yìdiǎnr ma?
text.english: I got fat recently. Can working out make me a bit thinner?

text.traditional: 健身也許能讓妳的體重減一、兩公斤，不過，最重要的目的是讓妳身體健康啊！
text.simplified: 健身也许能让你的体重减一、两公斤，不过，最重要的目的是让你身体健康啊！
text.pinyin: Jiànshēn yěxǔ néng ràng nǐ de tǐzhòng jiǎn yì, liǎng gōngjīn, búguò, zuì zhòngyào de mùdì shì ràng nǐ shēntǐ jiànkāng a!
text.english: Working out may make your body weight decrease one or two kilos. However, the most important purpose is to make your body healthy!

text.traditional: 我覺得健身太累了，要我跳幾下還可以，跑操場就沒辦法了。
text.simplified: 我觉得健身太累了，要我跳几下还可以，跑操场就没办法了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde jiànshēn tài lèi le, yào wǒ tiào jǐ xià hái kěyǐ, pǎo cāochǎng jiù méibànfǎ le.
text.english: I think working out is too tiring. Jumping a few times is still OK for me, but there is no way I can run on the playground.

text.traditional: 對啊！我不是十七、八歲的年輕人，太累的運動我也不喜歡。
text.simplified: 对啊！我不是十七、八岁的年轻人，太累的运动我也不喜欢。
text.pinyin: Duì a! Wǒ búshì shíqī, bā suì de niánqīngrén, tài lèi de yùndòng wǒ yě bù xǐhuān.
text.english: Right! I am not a 17- or 18-year-old youngster. I also don’t like too exhausting exercises.

text.traditional: 妳還是年輕人啊！而且健身跟年紀沒什麼關係，男人、女人、老人、小孩都應該多運動。
text.simplified: 你还是年轻人啊！而且健身跟年纪没什么关系，男人、女人、老人、小孩都应该多运动。
text.pinyin: Nǐ háishì niánqīngrén a! Érqiě jiànshēn gēn niánjì méishénme guānxì, nánrén, nǚrén, lǎorén, xiǎohái dōu yīnggāi duō yùndòng.
text.english: You are still young! Also, working out and age are not related in any way. Men and women, the elderly and kids, all should exercise a lot.

text.traditional: 聽說常健身的人不能亂吃，應該吃什麼？要吃多少？他們都非常注意。
text.simplified: 听说常健身的人不能乱吃，应该吃什么？要吃多少？他们都非常注意。
text.pinyin: Tīngshuō cháng jiànshēn de rén bùnéng luàn chī, yīnggāi chī shénme? Yào chī duōshǎo? Tāmen dōu fēicháng zhùyì.
text.english: I heard that people who work out often cannot eat indiscriminately. What should they eat? How much should they eat? They all take notice of that.

text.traditional: 這個我知道！比如說，多吃新鮮的青菜、水果，少吃漢堡、薯條、餅乾。
text.simplified: 这个我知道！比如说，多吃新鲜的青菜、水果，少吃汉堡、薯条、饼干。
text.pinyin: Zhège wǒ zhīdào! Bǐrú shuō, duō chī xīnxiān de qīngcài, shuǐguǒ, shǎo chī hànbǎo, shǔtiáo, bǐnggān.
text.english: I know that! For example, they eat more fresh vegetables and fruits, and eat less hamburgers, French fries and cookies.

text.traditional: 飲食最好也要少油、少鹽、少糖。如果渴了，也別喝可樂，喝開水比較健康，還可以省錢呢！
text.simplified: 饮食最好也要少油、少盐、少糖。如果渴了，也别喝可乐，喝开水比较健康，还可以省钱呢！
text.pinyin: Yǐnshí zuìhǎo yě yào shǎo yóu, shǎo yán, shǎo táng. Rúguǒ kě le, yě bié hē kělè, hē kāishuǐ bǐjiào jiànkāng, hái kěyǐ shěngqián ne!
text.english: It is best to have less oil, less salt and less sugar diet. If you are thirsty, don’t drink cola. Drinking boiled water is more healthy. Besides, you can save some money!

text.traditional: 好的生活習慣也是很重要的，像我哥哥常常開夜車，早上來不及吃早餐就去上班了。
text.simplified: 好的生活习惯也是很重要的，像我哥哥常常开夜车，早上来不及吃早餐就去上班了。
text.pinyin: Hǎo de shēnghuó xíguàn yě shì hěn zhòngyào de, xiàng wǒ gēge chángcháng kāiyèchē, zǎoshàng láibùjí chī zǎocān jiù qù shàngbān le.
text.english: Good living habits are also important. For example, my elder brother often burns the midnight oil. In the morning he has little time to have breakfast before going to work.

text.traditional: 這樣對身體不好喔！三餐很重要，特別是早餐。我聽德國人說，早餐要吃得像國王一樣好。
text.simplified: 这样对身体不好喔！三餐很重要，特别是早餐。我听德国人说，早餐要吃得像国王一样好。
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng duì shēntǐ bùhǎo o! Sāncān hěn zhòngyào, tèbié shì zǎocān. Wǒ tīng Déguó rén shuō, zǎocān yào chī de xiàng guówáng yíyàng hǎo.
text.english: This is not good for the body! The three meals are very important, especially breakfast. I heard the Germans say, “eat breakfast like a king!”

text.traditional: 說了這麼多，美心，妳到底要不要跟我們去健身呢？
text.simplified: 说了这么多，美心，你到底要不要跟我们去健身呢？
text.pinyin: Shuō le zhème duō, Měixīn, nǐ dàodǐ yào búyào gēn wǒmen qù jiànshēn ne?
text.english: We’ve talked so much, Meixin. After all, do you want to go to work out with us?

text.traditional: 要啊！等感冒好了就去，希望我們都可以健健康康地活到一百歲喔！哈哈哈！
text.simplified: 要啊！等感冒好了就去，希望我们都可以健健康康地活到一百岁喔！哈哈哈！
text.pinyin: Yào a! Děng gǎnmào hǎo le jiù qù, xīwàng wǒmen dōu kěyǐ jiàn jiànkāng kāng de huó dào yìbǎi suì o! Hāhāhā!
text.english: I will – when my cold gets better. I hope all of us can all live a healthy life until we are 100 years old! Hahaha!

text.traditional: 太好了！我就先訓練妳慢跑吧。
text.simplified: 太好了！我就先训练你慢跑吧。
text.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ jiù xiān xùnliàn nǐ mànpǎo ba.
text.english: Great! I’ll train you how to jog first.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.titleEnglish: From Someone’s Point of View: 對…來說
grammarPages.learnerPromise: State someone’s opinion or attitude about an event.
grammarPages.explanation: The pattern “對 NP 來說” is used to show someone’s opinion or attitude toward a specific event.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The pattern “對 NP 來說” is used to show someone’s opinion or attitude toward a specific event.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The pattern “對 NP 來說” is used to show someone’s opinion or attitude toward a specific event.

columns.traditional: what it is like for them
columns.simplified: what it is like for them

text.traditional: 對老師來說，日本學生的漢字很少寫錯，可是聲調常說錯。
text.simplified: 对老师来说，日本学生的汉字很少写错，可是声调常说错。
text.pinyin: Duì lǎoshī lái shuō, Rìběn xuéshēng de Hànzì hěn shǎo xiě cuò, kěshì shēngdiào cháng shuō cuò.
text.english: As far as teachers are concerned, Japanese students rarely write Chinese characters incorrectly, but often say the tones incorrectly.

text.traditional: 對遊客來說，參觀當地的美術館或博物館，都是不錯的選擇。
text.simplified: 对游客来说，参观当地的美术馆或博物馆，都是不错的选择。
text.pinyin: Duì yóukè lái shuō, cānguān dāngdì de měishùguǎn huò bówùguǎn, dōu shì búcuò de xuǎnzé.
text.english: For tourists, visiting either the local art museum or the local museum is a good choice.

text.traditional: A：那個牌子很有名，一件外套一萬元，我覺得不貴。B：對你這個有錢人來說是不貴，可是對一般人來說貴得很。
text.simplified: A：那个牌子很有名，一件外套一万元，我觉得不贵。B：对你这个有钱人来说是不贵，可是对一般人来说贵得很。
text.pinyin: A: Nà ge páizi hěn yǒumíng, yí jiàn wàitào yíwàn yuán, wǒ juéde bú guì. B: Duì nǐ zhè ge yǒu qián rén lái shuō shì bú guì, kěshì duì yìbānrén lái shuō guì dehěn.
text.english: A: That brand is famous. A coat costs NT$10,000, but I don’t think that’s expensive. B: For a rich person like you, it isn’t expensive, but for ordinary people it’s very expensive.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Place 的話 at the end of the condition clause.
grammarPages.explanation: In Chinese, “的話” has the same function as “如果” and “要是” to form conditional sentences. However, “如果” and “要是” should be placed at the beginning of a sentence while “的話” should be placed at the end of the first clause. In some cases, using “要是” gives a stronger or even threatening tone than using “如果”. Both “如果” and “要是” can collocate with “的話”, and either can be left out. “的話” is a less formal expression.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In Chinese, “的話” has the same function as “如果” and “要是” to form conditional sentences. However, “如果” and “要是” should be placed at the beginning of a sentence while “的話” should be placed at the end of the first clause. In some cases, using “要是” gives a stronger or even threatening tone than using “如果”. Both “如果” and “要是” can collocate with “的話”, and either can be left out. “的話” is a less formal expression.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In Chinese, “的話” has the same function as “如果” and “要是” to form conditional sentences. However, “如果” and “要是” should be placed at the beginning of a sentence while “的話” should be placed at the end of the first clause. In some cases, using “要是” gives a stronger or even threatening tone than using “如果”. Both “如果” and “要是” can collocate with “的話”, and either can be left out. “的話” is a less formal expression.

text.traditional: 要是你明天不來（的話），記得要先告訴我！
text.simplified: 要是你明天不来（的话），记得要先告诉我！
text.pinyin: Yàoshì nǐ míngtiān bù lái (dehuà), jìde yào xiān gàosu wǒ!
text.english: If you aren’t coming tomorrow, remember to tell me first!

text.traditional: （如果）你常運動的話，心情一定會比較好。
text.simplified: （如果）你常运动的话，心情一定会比较好。
text.pinyin: (Rúguǒ) nǐ cháng yùndòng dehuà, xīnqíng yídìng huì bǐjiào hǎo.
text.english: If you exercise often, you’ll definitely be in a better mood.

text.traditional: （要是）你不保養那輛汽車的話，可能會有問題的！
text.simplified: （要是）你不保养那辆汽车的话，可能会有问题的！
text.pinyin: (Yàoshì) nǐ bù bǎoyǎng nà liàng qìchē dehuà, kěnéng huì yǒu wèntí de!
text.english: If you don’t maintain that car, there may be a problem!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go Work Out after Class!
grammarPages.titleTraditional: 對……有／沒（有）幫助；有／沒（有）影響；有／沒（有）好處
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Helpful, Influential or Beneficial to Something
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe how something affects or benefits a person or thing.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern, in which “對” is followed by someone or something, indicates the Subject, often a thing, has influence on someone or something.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern, in which “對” is followed by someone or something, indicates the Subject, often a thing, has influence on someone or something.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern, in which “對” is followed by someone or something, indicates the Subject, often a thing, has influence on someone or something.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 對 + NP + 有／沒（有） + 幫助／影響／好處

text.traditional: 健身教練說，經常運動，對健康很有幫助。
text.simplified: 健身教练说，经常运动，对健康很有帮助。
text.pinyin: Jiànshēn jiàoliàn shuō, jīngcháng yùndòng, duì jiànkāng hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
text.english: The fitness coach says that exercising regularly is very good for your health.

text.traditional: 父母說的話，對我有很大的影響。
text.simplified: 父母说的话，对我有很大的影响。
text.pinyin: Fùmǔ shuō dehuà, duì wǒ yǒu hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
text.english: What my parents say has a big influence on me.

text.traditional: 每天吃喝玩樂對你的將來沒有好處，你應該好好地利用時間。
text.simplified: 每天吃喝玩乐对你的将来没有好处，你应该好好地利用时间。
text.pinyin: Měitiān chīhēwánlè duì nǐ de jiānglái méi yǒu hǎochù, nǐ yīnggāi hǎohǎo de lìyòng shíjiān.
text.english: Eating, drinking, and having fun every day is not good for your future. You should make good use of your time.

text.traditional: 對不運動的人來說，剛開始運動或許會覺得很辛苦，不過，要是願意每天跑步、打球，就會發現經常運動有很多好處。比如說，讓我們體力好、有精神、比較不容易生病。要是能跟家人或是朋友一起運動的話，不但身體會越來越健康，也會讓大家的關係更好呢！
text.simplified: 对不运动的人来说，刚开始运动或许会觉得很辛苦，不过，要是愿意每天跑步、打球，就会发现经常运动有很多好处。比如说，让我们体力好、有精神、比较不容易生病。要是能跟家人或是朋友一起运动的话，不但身体会越来越健康，也会让大家的关系更好呢！
text.pinyin: Duì bú yùndòng de rén lái shuō, gāng kāishǐ yùndòng huòxǔ huì juéde hěn xīnkǔ, búguò, yàoshì yuànyì měitiān pǎobù, dǎqiú, jiù huì fāxiàn jīngcháng yùndòng yǒu hěn duō hǎochù. Bǐrú shuō, ràng wǒmen tǐlì hǎo, yǒu jīngshén, bǐjiào bù róngyì shēngbìng. Yàoshì néng gēn jiārén huòshì péngyǒu yìqǐ yùndòng dehuà, búdàn shēntǐ huì yuèláiyuè jiànkāng, yě huì ràng dàjiā de guānxì gèng hǎo ne!
text.english: For those who don’t exercise, they might think that exercising is very hard in the beginning. However, if you are willing to run or play sports every day, you will find out that regular exercise brings many benefits. For example, it builds up our physical strength, makes us more energetic, and prevents us from getting sick easily. If you can exercise with your family or friends, not only will your body get healthier and healthier, but it can also improve your relationships!

text.traditional: 其實，運動對學習也有很大的幫助。在台灣，很多學生很用功，總是念書念到半夜才去睡覺，所以白天上課就沒有精神，容易打瞌睡。學校為了改善這個情況，除了讓學生睡午覺，每個星期也都會有一、兩堂體育課，學生去操場跑跑步、打打球，運動一下再繼續念書，一定比一直坐在教室裡好。
text.simplified: 其实，运动对学习也有很大的帮助。在台湾，很多学生很用功，总是念书念到半夜才去睡觉，所以白天上课就没有精神，容易打瞌睡。学校为了改善这个情况，除了让学生睡午觉，每个星期也都会有一、两堂体育课，学生去操场跑跑步、打打球，运动一下再继续念书，一定比一直坐在教室里好。
text.pinyin: Qíshí, yùndòng duì xuéxí yě yǒu hěn dà de bāngzhù. Zài Táiwān, hěn duō xuéshēng hěn yònggōng, zǒngshì niànshū niàn dào bànyè cái qù shuìjiào, suǒyǐ báitiān shàngkè jiù méiyǒu jīngshén, róngyì dǎ kēshuì. Xuéxiào wèile gǎishàn zhège qíngkuàng, chúle ràng xuéshēng shuì wǔjiào, měi ge xīngqí yě dōu huì yǒu yì, liǎng táng tǐyù kè, xuéshēng qù cāochǎng pǎo pǎobù, dǎ da qiú, yùndòng yíxià zài jìxù niànshū, yídìng bǐ yìzhí zuò zài jiàoshì lǐ hǎo.
text.english: In fact, exercise is of great help to learning. In Taiwan many students are very hard-working. They always study until midnight and go to bed late, so they have no energy and doze off easily in class during the day. In order to improve this situation, the school allows students to take a midday nap and organizes one or two PE classes a week. Students run and play balls on the playground, and exercise a bit before going back to studying. It’s certainly better than sitting in a classroom all the time.

text.traditional: 醫生也常建議病人多運動，因為運動能幫助他們恢復身體和心理的健康。如果你覺得心情不好，就出門去散散步、游游泳，或是在家裡做做家事，活動一下身體。這樣，也許就能把難過的事情忘了。
text.simplified: 医生也常建议病人多运动，因为运动能帮助他们恢复身体和心理的健康。如果你觉得心情不好，就出门去散散步、游游泳，或是在家里做做家事，活动一下身体。这样，也许就能把难过的事情忘了。
text.pinyin: Yīshēng yě cháng jiànyì bìngrén duō yùndòng, yīnwèi yùndòng néng bāngzhù tāmen huīfù shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng. Rúguǒ nǐ juéde xīnqíng bùhǎo, jiù chūmén qù sàn sànbù, yóu yóuyǒng, huòshì zài jiālǐ zuò zuò jiāshì, huódòng yíxià shēntǐ. Zhèyàng, yěxǔ jiù néng bǎ nánguò de shìqíng wàngle.
text.english: Also, doctors often advise their patients to exercise more, because exercising can help them regain physical and mental health. If you have a bad mood, go out for a walk, swim, or do some housework at home to move your body for a while. This way you may forget all the sad things.

text.traditional: 運動有這麼多的好處，讓我們脫下牛仔褲、穿上運動服，一起去運動吧！
text.simplified: 运动有这么多的好处，让我们脱下牛仔裤、穿上运动服，一起去运动吧！
text.pinyin: Yùndòng yǒu zhème duō de hǎochù, ràng wǒmen tuōxià niúzǎikù, chuān shàng yùndòngfú, yìqǐ qù yùndòng ba!
text.english: Exercising has so many benefits. Let’s take our jeans off, put on some sportswear, and go exercise together!
